# Open Health Care Clinic

> > Open Health Care Clinic (OHCC) provides comprehensive primary care, behavioral health, dental, HIV/AIDS services, and social support across multiple locations in Baton Rouge and Denham Springs, Louisiana.

Open Health serves the Greater Baton Rouge community through integrated healthcare delivery, including specialized HIV care at the HAART Clinic, Ryan White case management, and accessible dental and podiatry services. Led by medical professionals including Dr. Rani Whitfield, the clinic focuses on community health and healthcare access for underserved populations.

## Key Topics

- Primary care services
- Behavioral health
- HIV care and PrEP
- Dental services
- Chronic disease management
- Ryan White case management
- Sexual wellness and STI testing
- Community health
- Healthcare access
- Baton Rouge healthcare
- HAART Clinic
- Social services
- Podiatry
- Patient resources

## Clinic Locations

- [HAART Clinic in Central Baton Rouge - Open Health](https://www.ohcc.org/haart-clinic): HAART Clinic location offering HIV care, PrEP, STI testing, and wellness
- [Airline Highway Clinic in Baton Rouge | Open Health](https://www.ohcc.org/airline-highway-clinic): Airline Highway location for primary care, behavioral health, and dental
- [Open Health Care Clinic in Denham Springs | Primary Care](https://www.ohcc.org/denham-springs): Denham Springs clinic offering family care, pediatrics, and behavioral health

## Medical Services

- [Adult Primary Care (Copy)](https://www.ohcc.org/adult-primary-care-copy-1): Adult primary care including wellness, chronic disease, and HIV screening
- [Dental Clinic in Baton Rouge | Open Health Care Clinic](https://www.ohcc.org/dental-clinic): Dental services including pediatric, adult, and restorative dentistry
- [Baton Rouge Podiatry Services Near Me | Open Health Care](https://www.ohcc.org/podiatry): Podiatry services for foot, ankle, and diabetic foot care in Baton Rouge
- [Baton Rouge Social Services Near Me | Open Health Care](https://www.ohcc.org/social-services): Ryan White case management, housing assistance, and HIV support services
